articles.summary: H.B. Fuller Company (“H.B. Fuller”) (NYSE:FUL) announced today that it has priced an offering of $850 million aggregate principal amount of 7.625% new senior unsecured notes due 2034 (the “Notes”) at an issue price of 100% of the principal amount, in a private offering (the “Notes Offering”) that is exempt from the registration requirements of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”). The issuance of the Notes is expected to close on or about October 21, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. The Notes will pay interest on a semi-annual basis. H.B. Fuller intends to use the net proceeds from the Notes Offering, together with other available cash and borrowings, to fund the purchase price for the acquisition (the “Acquisition”) of Advanced Medical Solutions Group plc (“AMS”), to repay other borrowings under its Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of February 15, 2023, as amended, and to fund the repayment or redemption of H.B. articles.summary: H.B. Fuller Company (NYSE: FUL) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.2450 per share of common stock, payable on October 29, 2026 to shareholders of record at the close of business on October 15, 2026. H.B. Fuller has paid quarterly cash dividends on its common stock for 58 consecutive years. About H.B. Fuller As the largest pureplay adhesives company in the world, H.B. Fuller’s (NYSE: FUL) innovative, functional coatings, adhesives and sealants enhance the quality, safety and performance of products people use every day. Founded in 1887, with 2025 revenue of $3.5 billion, our mission to Connect What Matters is brought to life by more than 7,100 global team members who collaborate with customers across more than 30 market segments in 150 countries to develop highly specified solutions that enable customers to bring world-changing innovations to their end markets. Learn more at www.hbfuller.com . Scott Jensen Investor

articles.summary: Announces market check for select market segments H.B. Fuller Company (“H.B. Fuller” or “the Company”) (NYSE: FUL), the world’s largest pureplay adhesives company, today announced that following a thorough review supported by independent financial and legal advisors, its Board of Directors has unanimously rejected Ancora’s second unsolicited, non-binding proposal to acquire its Building Adhesive Solutions (“BAS”) business for between $1.2 billion and $1.4 billion in cash. The Board determined that the modest offer price increase does not adequately capture the value of the BAS business, including its organic growth momentum, the significant role it plays within H.B. Fuller’s broader platform, and the upside inherent in it from Project Quantum Leap. The Board also considered that the offer continued to lack key details, leaving the Board to conclude the terms to be highly conditional. H.B. Fuller’s Board continues to evaluate all opportunities to maximize value for all shareholders. To
articles.title: H.B. Fuller Board Unanimously Rejects Second Unsolicited, Non-Binding Proposal for Building Adhesive Solutions Segment
